flows.title: Set call routing rules for a department
steps: Open your Dialpad Admin Settings and go to Departments.

Select the department, open Business hours & call routing, then select Edit Call Routing. When the department has its own business hours, walk through this once for open hours and once for closed hours.

To ring people, choose an operator routing type: Longest idle, Fixed order, Round robin, or Simultaneous, which rings everyone at once. You can also set how long calls ring before the fallback takes them.

To ring nobody, choose No operator and pick where calls go instead: straight to voicemail, to a message, to another department, to a team member or room phone, to an automated response menu, to a voice workflow, or to an AI agent.
Set the welcome greeting, the ring duration and the hold queue with its size, wait time and hold music.
Set the fallback for when no operator is free. Fallback options only appear when the routing option is Operators.

flows.title: Restore a deleted team member
steps: Open your Dialpad Admin Settings and go to Office Settings, then select Users. This needs an admin.
Select the Deleted Users tab. A deleted user sits there for 72 hours and their number is held, so it cannot be reassigned during that time.
Select Options beside the user's name, then select Restore, which brings back the user's number and data.
After the 72 hours the user's data is gone for good. People on a free trial do not see the Deleted Users tab at all.
